target_customer: Consumers and gamers who want a VR headset blending virtual and physical worlds
problem: Existing VR headsets isolate users from the physical world; UNISON pitched a unified reality headset to move between virtual and real worlds.
business_model: Consumer hardware sales (headset in development, no shipped product found)
product_category: VR and mixed reality headset hardware

competitors.name: Meta Quest 2
competitors.traction_then: Quest 2 held about 75 percent of global XR shipments in Q1 2021 and about 78 percent for 2021 per IDC

competitors.name: Pico and DPVR
competitors.traction_then: Pico about 4.5 percent and DPVR about 5.1 percent of 2021 sales per IDC

technical_complexity.rationale: A custom headset needs optics, displays, sensors, mixed reality passthrough and an OS; this is a hardware effort beyond a small team's usual reach.

defensibility.rationale: No shipped product or visible moat was found; Meta dominated the consumer market with subsidised hardware.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well-resourced players were building mixed reality headsets. UNISON has not shipped a product and now describes itself as seeding new tools.

market_need_then: VR headset shipments nearly tripled year on year in Q1 2021 and Quest 2 sold 8.7 million units in 2021 (IDC via Android Central), showing consumer demand for VR hardware.

branding.domain_note: Earlier domain in-unison.com redirects to unison.co; the original name Unai appears in one CB Insights listing (unverified).

identity.voice_and_tone: Philosophical: use computers when useful, create rather than consume

brand_strength.rationale: Little press or community found; the name collides with other products called Unison.

outcome_analysis: UNISON is an Active hardware startup that entered YC in W22 with a headset pitch and later raised a Series A led by Lachy Groom and General Catalyst according to its own site. No shipped product, revenue or round size was found, and its site now frames it as seeding new tools, so the outcome is unresolved.
notes: YC page lists no founders and the company site names none, so founders are left empty. One search snippet attributed founding to Max Coutte under the earlier name Unai but no opened source confirmed it. Aggregators conflict on funding: CB Insights 5.5M over 4 rounds including a 0.5M convertible note on 2022-03-30; Simplify lists 500K pre-seed. These are unverified and excluded. The Series A claim comes only from the company's own site. Name collision with LAYER's Unison headset and other firms; those were ignored. No news of shutdown, acquisition or layoffs was found.
